context: Analyze the selected stripped ARM64 executable, a complete source-built Chocolate Doom 3.1.1 whose gameplay constants were privately changed. Do not answer from stock Doom values: some are deliberately different. No dehacked patch is applied at runtime. All values refer to this executable's compiled defaults, with no armor, skill reduction, damage resistance, hit/miss variation or later runtime patches. Work from static binary evidence. You have no source, symbol sidecar or answer key. Addresses in answers must be program virtual addresses. Hexadecimal decompiler constants may need conversion. State UNKNOWN using null rather than inventing a value. Find code using string cross-references, function callers/callees, tables and instruction inspection. Recovered function names may be synthetic. Source names below describe semantics to identify, not labels guaranteed to survive stripping.

questions.text: Recover the damage formula used by the shared player gunshot routine (the P_GunShot semantic role, used by pistol/chaingun and ordinary shotgun pellets). Give its integer random-roll multiplier, minimum raw damage and maximum raw damage for one pellet. The random roll in this routine has three alternatives. Cite the implementing function and arithmetic.

For one ordinary single-barrel shotgun trigger, recover the number of calls/pellets and theoretical minimum and maximum total raw damage if every pellet hits. Exclude the super shotgun and monster shotgun attacks. Cite the trigger loop/call sites and shared pellet damage calculation.

Recover the Imp's compiled default spawn health and its integer movement speed from the entity definition table (Imp map-editor thing type 3001). Report the stored integer speed, not a conversion into units per second. Cite the table record and explain how it was identified.

Recover the Baron of Hell's compiled default spawn health and stored integer movement speed (map-editor thing type 3003). Distinguish it from the Hell Knight. Cite the relevant entity definition table record.

Recover the player's rocket projectile speed from its entity definition, expressed as the integer coefficient of FRACUNIT (65536). This is the rocket launcher projectile, not an Imp fireball or a rocket-launcher monster's animation speed. Cite the table address and evidence identifying the projectile.

Recover the Pinky/Spectre demon melee attack's random damage multiplier and minimum/maximum raw damage before target-side adjustments. This is the A_SargAttack semantic role, whose random roll has ten alternatives. Cite its implementing function and arithmetic.
